== English errata comparison sources ==
The Decipher Supplement revises the final cancellation clause. The printed face and complete PC reproductions retain Alter immunity. The two former qualified articles have identical replacement game text and the same main face. They represent one Decipher replacement. The promotional foil is a separate physical publication.

Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=5 Glossary Supplement], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 5. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=8 Decipher Errata], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 8. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=117 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 117. [[:File:CC-D-imperialdecree.gif|Complete replacement face]]. The later PC illustration survives on the canonical Decipher article. The old historical routing key 5_120-DE is a compatibility redirect and is absent from the pinned executable mapping. The older Talk notes remain available in place.
